subject: PoC / trial plan & deployment mode follow-up - Acme Corp
body_plain:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Chris Lopez <chris.lopez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Dana Kim <dana.kim@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: PoC / trial plan & deployment mode follow-up - Acme Corp

Hi Chris / Dana,

Thanks again for the call this morning - great to learn more about Acme's high-throughput search augmentation use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

Summary of needs we heard:
- Primary requirement: predictable throughput for ~10k concurrent QPS with sub-200ms generation latency for the RAG pipeline.
- Data isolation / compliance is important - Acme will require VPC peering and audit logs for the pilot.
- Long-term preference seems to be Dedicated capacity with optional Private VPC/on-prem if procurement requires it, but you asked about Hosted API as a faster ramp for evaluation.

Proposed PoC approach (high level):
- Short pilot (4 weeks) on Dedicated capacity with VPC peering + KV cache enabled to validate latency and throughput.
- Success criteria: 1) sustained 10k QPS with <200ms median gen latency on representative load; 2) no data leakage and audit logging enabled; 3) model quality parity vs your baseline on defined evaluation prompts.
- Resources: Redwood SE (Marissa) to run box-level validation + runbench; product + infra to support config; procurement review for T&Cs.

Attachments: I attached a one-pager PoC plan for your review (redwood-poc-plan.pdf).

Can you confirm: 1) the suggested success criteria above reflect Acme's view?; 2) who from your side needs to be involved (security, infra, procurement) and their preferred timeline (you mentioned Jan for a pilot)?

If that looks right I can loop in Marissa (SE) and Ben (sales ops) to draft a formal trial plan and schedule a kickoff. I can also surface SOC2 evidence immediately - would you like that attached now?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Calendly: https://calendly.com/jordan-redwood/kickoff

---
Attachment: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (1 page PoC summary)

From: Chris Lopez <chris.lopez@acmecorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Dana Kim <dana.kim@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 12:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PoC / trial plan & deployment mode follow-up - Acme Corp

Jordan, thanks for the recap and the plan - this matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

- Deployment mode: Our preference is Dedicated capacity (predictable performance and isolation). We will require VPC peering and the option to move to a Private VPC/on-prem in the next quarter if procurement asks for it. Hosted API is OK for an internal spike but won’t satisfy security for the pilot.
- Success criteria: agree with your three bullets. Add a 4th: ability to rotate keys and demonstrate audit trails for token-level requests.
- Timeline: target pilot start week of Jan 10, 2027. Procurement will need ~2 weeks to review SOW/T&Cs once we receive it.
- Stakeholders: me (product), Dana Kim (Infra lead), Maria Perez (Security - maria.perez@acmecorp.com), and procurement@acmecorp.com. Please cc Maria on security items.

Please send SOC2 evidence and the PoC/trial plan with estimated SE hours and pricing for the Dedicated trial. Procurement prefers to see an explicit limited-time credit or demo pricing for the one-month pilot.

Thanks,
Chris Lopez
Sr. Product Manager | Acme Corp

---
Attachment: acme-deploy-requirements.docx (their internal deployment constraints)

Date: Sat, 06 Dec 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PoC / trial plan & deployment mode follow-up - Acme Corp

Hi all - draft PoC/trial plan attached (poc-trial-plan-acme-v1.pdf). High level summary and ask:

PoC objectives / success criteria:
- Perf: sustain representative load equivalent to 10k concurrent QPS with median generation latency <200ms for the evaluation prompt set.
- Reliability: zero unexpected errors under sustained load and KV cache hit rate >= 70% for repeated traffic patterns.
- Security/Compliance: VPC peering + audit logs enabled; demonstrate key rotation and request-level auditing; provide SOC2 artifact (attached SOC2_evidence_stub.pdf).
- Quality: model outputs meet or exceed baseline EM/ROUGE thresholds on the provided eval set.

Plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (Jan 3-7): infra setup - provision Dedicated capacity, configure VPC peering, network tests.
- Week 1 (Jan 10-14): load testing + tuning with Redwood SE onsite remotely; capture latency/throughput metrics.
- Week 2 (Jan 17-21): integration tests with Acme RAG pipeline, validation vs quality metrics.
- Week 3 (Jan 24-28): regression checks, final acceptance, handoff to Acme infra.

SE / resource ask:
- Redwood SE: 40 hours over Weeks 1-2 (Marissa + 1 engineer).
- Infra: network engineer rotation for VPC peering (joint troubleshoot).
- Product: one hour/week for acceptance criteria review.

Deliverables:
- PoC runbook and test scripts, perf report, audit log dump (sample), SOC2 evidence, and a short executive summary.

Pricing suggestion (initial):
- Offer a one-month Dedicated trial with a 50% reserved-capacity credit applied to first month to simplify procurement signoff. Ben to confirm exact numbers.

Next steps: Jordan/Ben to share pricing & SOW; Marissa to schedule kickoff after procurement confirms timeline.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0199
